# Tidepool Landing Page: Build Plan

**Global system**
- **Palette:** Deep teal ink `#0F3B3F` for text and dark sections, sand `#F6F1E7` for backgrounds, seafoam `#5FC4B0` for accents, coral `#E8745B` for primary CTAs only.
- **Type:** Fraunces (soft serif) for headlines, Inter for body and UI.
- **Imagery:** Flat illustrations of tidepool life (shells, anemones, small fish) for decoration. Product screenshots in rounded frames. No stock photos.

**1. Nav**
Sticky, sand background. Wordmark left; Product, Pricing, Teams center-right; "Log in" text link and coral "Start free" button right.

**2. Hero**
Two columns, 55/45. Left: H1 "Plan your week together, in ten minutes." Subhead names the outcome: "One shared view of priorities, handoffs, and who's out, every Monday." Coral primary button "Start your week," ghost button "See a sample week." Right: a static, angled mock of a five-column week board with colored task cards. Small wave illustration along the bottom edge.

**3. Logo strip**
Single row of four grayscale customer wordmarks above a thin divider. Caption: "Used by 400+ teams of 2 to 12."

**4. Problem**
Full-width teal background, white Fraunces type. Three short lines, each on its own row: "Five tabs. One standup nobody prepared for. Priorities that changed on Tuesday." Copy is blunt, second person, no adjectives.

**5. How it works**
Three columns on sand, each with a numbered seafoam circle and a small illustration. Steps: *Gather* (add the week's work in one place), *Align* (drag tasks onto days and see load per person), *Close* (Friday recap writes itself). Verb-led headings, two-sentence descriptions.

**6. Feature showcase**
Two zig-zag rows. Row one: capacity view with per-person bars. Row two: recurring rituals and handoffs. Each gets a screenshot, a one-line headline, and three bullets maximum.

**7. Testimonial**
Centered, large Fraunces italic quote on white. Attribution includes name, role, and team size ("Ops lead, 6-person agency"). Circular illustrated avatar.

**8. Pricing**
Three tiers. Middle tier highlighted with a seafoam border. Monthly/annual toggle. Copy is plain: "Free for teams of three." No feature lists longer than five items.

**9. FAQ**
Two columns: heading and short intro left, accordion of five questions right. Cover integrations, data export, team size limits, and cancellation.

**10. Final CTA**
Full-width seafoam band. Centered headline "Your team's next week starts here." One coral button. No other links.

**11. Footer**
Teal background, sand text. Four link columns, wordmark, and a small-print line.

# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

**What changed:** The reference's sidebar timeline and hand-drawn arrow both fit Tidepool's weekly focus, so I adopted them. Its monospace quote works for the Friday-recap testimonial. I kept our headline short, since the reference's 40-word headline buries the outcome. I also replaced the logo strip's unverified "400+ teams" claim with a placeholder that must be confirmed before launch.

**Global system**
- **Palette:** Deep forest `#12372A` for text and dark sections, sand `#F6F1E7` for backgrounds, seafoam `#5FC4B0` for accents and timeline nodes, coral `#E8745B` for primary CTAs only.
- **Type:** Fraunces for headlines, Inter for body and UI, JetBrains Mono for the testimonial and small labels.
- **Imagery:** Flat tidepool illustrations for decoration. Product screenshots in rounded frames. A hand-drawn coral annotation appears once, in the hero.

**1. Nav**
Sticky, sand background. Wordmark left; Product, Pricing, Teams center-right; "Log in" text link and coral "Start free" button right.

**2. Hero**
Two columns, 55/45. Left: H1 "Plan your week together, in ten minutes." Subhead: "One shared view of priorities, handoffs, and who's out, every Monday." Coral "Start your week" button and ghost "See a sample week" button. Right: an angled five-column week board screenshot. A hand-drawn coral arrow runs from the headline to the board, with the handwritten note "everyone, same Monday."

**3. Proof strip**
Single row on sand. If customer logos are approved, show four grayscale wordmarks. If not, show one real metric or a one-line quote in place of logos. Do not publish a team count until it is verified.

**4. Problem**
Full-width forest background, white Fraunces type. Three short rows: "Five tabs. One standup nobody prepared for. Priorities that changed on Tuesday." Blunt, second person, no adjectives.

**5. How it works**
A sticky vertical week timeline runs down the left: Mon through Fri, each a node. Steps sit on the right: *Gather* (Monday), *Align* (Tuesday to Wednesday), *Close* (Friday). As the reader scrolls, nodes fill seafoam in sequence. On mobile, the timeline becomes a horizontal day strip above the steps.

**6. Feature showcase**
Two zig-zag rows. Row one: capacity view with per-person bars. Row two: recurring rituals and handoffs. Each has a screenshot with a small mono label, a one-line headline, and three bullets maximum.

**7. Testimonial**
Centered on sand. The quote is set in JetBrains Mono at large size, as if pasted from a Friday recap. Attribution: name, role, team size ("Ops lead, 6-person agency"). Quote a specific outcome, such as time saved per week.

**8. Pricing**
Three tiers. Middle tier has a seafoam border. Annual toggle defaults to annual, with the savings shown beside it. Copy is plain: "Free for teams of three." Five feature items maximum per tier.

**9. FAQ**
Two columns: heading and short intro left, five-question accordion right. Cover integrations, data export, team size limits, and cancellation.

**10. Final CTA**
Full-width seafoam band. Centered headline "Your team's next week starts here." One coral button, no other links.

**11. Footer**
Forest background, sand text. Four link columns, wordmark, small-print line.
